narr: A typical summertime pattern prevailed with scattered afternoon thunderstorms across portions of southwest and south-central Georgia. There were a few reports of wind damage with the strongest storms. In addition, pockets of flash flooding were observed due to very heavy rainfall of 3 to 5 inches in 1 to 2 hours.
ev: Roads were closed due to flooding in the Colquitt area.
Significant street flooding occurred in Donalsonville due to rainfall of 3-5 inches in 1-2 hours. Social media pictures confirmed the flooding.
lsr: ROADS CLOSED DUE TO FLOODING IN THE COLQUITT AREA.
